name: yandex_direct-mcp
description: Yandex Direct (Яндекс Директ) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, pause_resume. Every tool map

platform_mcp_yandex_direct_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YANDEX_DIRECT_TOKEN
platform_mcp_yandex_direct_token.description: Yandex OAuth token of the Direct user (app registered at oauth.yandex.com with Direct API access approved; https://yandex.com/dev/direct/doc/en/concepts/auth-token), sent as Authorization: Bearer.

platform_mcp_yandex_direct_client_login.title: PLATFORM_MCP_YANDEX_DIRECT_CLIENT_LOGIN
platform_mcp_yandex_direct_client_login.description: Advertiser login to act for, sent as the Client-Login header (required for agency and representative tokens; omit for a direct advertiser).

tools.name: me
tools.description: POST /json/v5/clients {method: get}: the advertiser the token (or Client-Login) acts for ({result: {Clients: [{ClientId, Login, Currency}]}}).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: POST /json/v5/clients {method: get}: the advertiser the token acts for (agencies list clients through the AgencyClients service instead). `id` is the Login usable as the client_login config.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: POST /json/v5/campaigns {method: get, params: {SelectionCriteria: {States: [status]}, FieldNames, Page: {Limit, Offset}}} for the token's advertiser (account_id is not sent; set client_login for agencies). `status` filters State: ON, OFF, SUSPENDED, ENDED, ARCHIVED. budget_micros is DailyBudget.Amount, the currency amount multiplied by 1,000,000.

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: POST /json/v5/campaigns {method: suspend|resume, params: {SelectionCriteria: {Ids: [campaign_id]}}}. Per-campaign problems come back inside suspend_result/resume_result.Errors (Yandex's operation-array pattern), so check it; request-level errors are reported as failures. Resuming restarts spending.
